Monotone one-step coupling yields exact pure-birth projection norm; independent geometric holding times give rational generating functions and sharp constants. Bounded martingale SLLN yields universal speed. For beta weights explicit O(log m) binomial coupling controls Gaussian CLT and logarithmic drift. 466 exact-rational finite checks agree but are not substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an intrinsic quantitative stability classification for a natural newly defined operator: all compact inputs decay but uniform decay is impossible; finite-corner spectral constants and a moment-controlled ballistic degree front quantify the failure, with a Gaussian critical window for standard beta Bergman spaces. This provides sharp natural finite-rank complexity scales and is neither a routine fixed-point corollary nor an arbitrary parameter slice.
